# Recap Studio

> Understand what changed, in one page you can send. Recap Studio makes one HTML page from your coding session or a topic. It opens with a double-click, offline. Claude Code plugin, CLI and MCP server. Works with any agent that reads skills and any MCP client; the writing uses your agent's model. Version 0.6.4, MIT.

The page is one file: all CSS inlined, zero JavaScript, zero external requests.
Seven offline checks score it before you share it. The score checks shape, not truth, so read the sources first.
The CLI and the MCP server are one committed file, `bin/recap.mjs`, with no dependency.
Nothing is published to npm; `npx -y github:Aboudjem/recap-studio` runs it from GitHub.

## Install

- Recommended, any of 78 agents (Vercel skills CLI, for all your projects): `npx skills add Aboudjem/recap-studio -g`, then pick your agent in the menu. It installs the skills only; the MCP server is a separate step (below). Page: https://skills.sh/aboudjem/recap-studio
- Straight into one agent: `npx skills add Aboudjem/recap-studio -g -a <agent> -y` (drop `-g` for this project only)
- Claude Code plugin (adds the 13 research agents, safety hooks and the MCP server): `claude plugin marketplace add Aboudjem/10x` then `claude plugin install recap-studio@10x`
- CLI, no install: `npx -y github:Aboudjem/recap-studio demo`
- MCP server (stdio): command `npx`, args `["-y", "github:Aboudjem/recap-studio", "mcp"]`

## Validation scores are heuristics

`recap validate` and the MCP tool `validate_content` run seven deterministic checks: structure,
citations, word counts, secret and fluff scans. They do not fetch sources and do not call a model.
The 13 specialist agents run only inside an agent session, through `/recap`.

## Skills

- `recap`: router for `/recap` (topic, session, or demo)
- `recap-topic`: a cited explainer on a topic
- `recap-session`: an explainer of a git diff and its commits
- `recap-setup`: writes a config with every side effect off
- `recap-validate`: runs the review board and the deterministic score
